            $(document).ready(function () {
                  function getParameterByName(name) {
                        var url = window.location.href;
                        name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, '\\$&');
                        var regex = new RegExp('[?&]' + name + '(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)'),
                              results = regex.exec(url);
                        if (!results) return null;
                        if (!results[2]) return '';
                        return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
                  }
                  let prid = parseInt(getParameterByName('PRID'), 10);

                  if (!isNaN(prid) && prid > 0) {
                        $.ajax({
                              type: "POST",
                              url: "AjaxMethod.aspx/UpdatePRHitCount",
                              async: false,
                              data: JSON.stringify({ 'PermId': prid }),
                              contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                              dataType: "json",
                              success: function (response) {
                                    console.log(response);
                              },
                              error: function (error) {
                                    console.log("Error in AJAX request", error);
                              }
                        });
                  } else {
                        console.log("Invalid parameters:", prid);
                  }
            });

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">online markets) and 1465 villages covering all States/UTs through personal visits by field staff of</span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Field Operations Division of NSO, MoSPI on a weekly roster. <span style="color:black">During </span><span style="color:#0d0d0d">October </span><span style="color:black">2026, the response rate was 100% in both rural and urban markets.</span></span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify">&nbsp;</p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">CPI for November 2026 will be released on <strong>14<sup>th</sup> December, 2026</strong> <strong>(Monday)</strong> or the next working day in case of 14<sup>th</sup> being a holiday.</span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">State and Item wise indices for <span style="color:#0d0d0d">October, </span>2026 may be downloaded from eSankhyiki portal of MoSPI- <a href="https://esankhyiki.mospi.gov.in/" target="_blank"><em>https://esankhyiki.mospi.gov.in/</em></a></span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">State-level item indices available on the portal should be interpreted and used with caution, as the indices for some items may have been compiled using thin samples of price quotations. </span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Indices at all levels and inflation rates are compiled using the actual index values without rounding off. However, the indices published are rounded off to two decimal places. Therefore, higher-level indices, if calculated from the published figures may observe minute differences.</span></span></p>

				<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px"><span style="color:black">The reference period for price reporting for petrol, diesel and LPG prices are 15<sup>th</sup> of the corresponding month</span>.</span></span></p>

        <script type="text/javascript">
                  const festivalStart = new Date("2025-11-20T00:00:00").getTime();
                  const festivalEnd = new Date("2025-11-28T23:59:59").getTime();
                  const countdownElement = document.getElementById("countdown");

                  if (countdownElement) {
                        const interval = setInterval(() => {
                              const now = new Date().getTime();

                              if (now < festivalStart) {
                                    const diff = festivalStart - now;
                                    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                                    const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));

                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `${days} Day${days !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ${hours} Hour${hours !== 1 ? 's' : ''} to go`;
                              } else if (now >= festivalStart && now <= festivalEnd) {
                                    const dayNumber = Math.floor((now - festivalStart) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `56th IFFI - Day ${dayNumber}`;
                              } else {
                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `✨ IFFI closes but never ends…`;
                                    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.film-roll-badge');
                                    elements.forEach(el => el.style.width = "350px");
                                    clearInterval(interval);
                              }
                        }, 1000);
                  }
        </script>

    <!-- Minimal O(N) Time and O(1) Auxiliary Space Word Count & Read Time Calculation -->
    <script type="text/javascript">
            (function () {
                  function calculateReadingStats() {
                        var bodyEl = document.getElementById("pibReleaseBody");
                        if (!bodyEl) return;

                        // textContent extracts text without triggering expensive layout/reflow computations
                        var text = bodyEl.textContent || "";
                        var words = 0;
                        var inWord = false;

                        // O(N) single pass character code scan: achieves O(1) space with zero array allocations
                        for (var i = 0, len = text.length; i < len; i++) {
                              var code = text.charCodeAt(i);
                              // Delimits on ASCII whitespace, control characters, tabs, newlines, and non-breaking spaces (160)
                              if (code <= 32 || code === 160) {
                                    inWord = false;
                              } else if (!inWord) {
                                    inWord = true;
                                    words++;
                              }
                        }

                        // Standard 250 WPM reading speed (e.g., 612 words yields 2 min read)
                        var minutes = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 250));

                        var elWords = document.getElementById("prWordCount");
                        var elTime = document.getElementById("prReadTime");

                        if (elWords) elWords.textContent = words + (words === 1 ? " word" : " words");
                        if (elTime) elTime.textContent = minutes + " min read";
                  }

                  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", calculateReadingStats);
                  } else {
                        calculateReadingStats();
                  }
            })();
    </script>
